items.sentence: In nature, optimal levels of resources for growth are not always available; therefore plants have many different strategies related to coping with water loss or excess in various extremes.
items.prompt: not always available의 의미로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.

items.sentence: Successful businesspeople and managers who achieve the best results were not necessarily the most intelligent in their classes at school.
items.prompt: not necessarily의 의미로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
choices: were possibly the most intelligent but not definitely so
were not the most intelligent in any way
items.answer: were possibly the most intelligent but not definitely so

items.sentence: Even though there is argument over what constitutes a hero, few among us fail to admire heroic acts.
items.prompt: few among us fail to admire heroic acts의 의미로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
choices: almost all of us admire heroic acts
none of us admire heroic acts
items.answer: almost all of us admire heroic acts
items.explanation: few가 fail to admire를 제한하므로 ‘존경하지 않는 사람은 거의 없다’ 즉 거의 모두 존경한다는 뜻입니다.

items.sentence: Not all difficult sentences require a long explanation.

items.answer: 어려운 문장이라고 모두 긴 설명이 필요한 것은 아니다.
